settings: research_v3.config.V3_DEFAULT (^IRX cash yield, cost 5 bps + slippage 5 bps per side)
trend_filter: price above trend SMA (research_v2 strict >), weekly K-week SMA
unfilled_slots: v2 convention: weights renormalised over selected assets; 100% CASH only if none qualifies

ENS.description: momentum score = mean of 3/6/12 month momentum, each computed by v2 compute_weekly_momentum (same anchors, one-week skip)

BUF.description: held asset stays selected if it passes trend and rank <= buffer_rank; remaining slots filled by best-ranked passing assets; v2 tie-break

IVOL.description: selected assets weighted proportional to 1/sigma; sigma = sample std (ddof=1) of daily adj_close log returns over the last vol_window returns ending at signal close; total risky weight unchanged

TRANCHE.description: monthly only; n_tranches independent sub-portfolios with equal initial capital; sub-portfolio k rebalances monthly on the k-th (0-based) weekly event of each month (last event if fewer); BASE logic; costs per sub-portfolio, no netting; total NAV is the sum

COMBO.description: ENS + BUF + IVOL; monthly cadence additionally TRANCHE
